question: As announced in June 2025 by the Union Power and Urban Affairs Minister, what is the minimum temperature setting mandated for new air‑conditioners in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20°C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Union Power and Urban Affairs Minister** announced in **June 2025** a new regulatory mandate that sets the **minimum temperature setting** for all new **Room Air Conditioners (RACs)** at **20°C**.
 
• This decision is aimed at enhancing **energy efficiency** across the country, as cooling below this threshold often leads to disproportionate **electricity consumption** compared to the actual comfort gained.
 
• The policy requires **manufacturers** to lock the lower limit of the temperature range on the thermostat of new units to ensure they cannot be operated below **20°C**.
